questions.question_text: Swāminārāyaṇ nāmnā mantra jevo bījo koī mantra āj ......... nathī.
questions.explanation: The exact words from Swamini Vato 1/153 are: Swāminārāyaṇ nāmnā mantra jevo bījo koī mantra āj baḷiyo nathī.

questions.question_text: Swāminārāyaṇ nāmnā mantre kevā nāgnu paṇ jher na chaḍe?
questions.explanation: The exact words from Swamini Vato 1/153 are: e mantre kāḷā nāgnu paṇ jher na chaḍe.
The exact words from Shastriji Maharajno Patra are: Shāstrījī Mahārāje prasangopātt uchchārelā chār mahāvākyo.
The exact words from Shastriji Maharajno Patra are: Āpaṇe to Aksharpurushottamnā baḷadiyā chhīe.

questions.question_text: Aksharpurushottam māṭe āpaṇe ......... paḍe to paṇ te ochhu chhe.
questions.explanation: The exact words from Shastriji Maharajno Patra are: Aksharpurushottam māṭe āpaṇe vechāvu paḍe to paṇ te ochhu chhe.

questions.question_text: Aksharpurushottamni vāt koī mārā ......... par besīne kare toy ochhu chhe.
questions.explanation: The exact words from Shastriji Maharajno Patra are: Aksharpurushottamni vāt koī mārā māthā par besīne kare toy ochhu chhe.

questions.question_text: Ā munḍāvyu chhe te ......... māṭe munḍāvyu chhe.
questions.explanation: The exact words from Shastriji Maharajno Patra are: Ā munḍāvyu chhe te Aksharpurushottam māṭe munḍāvyu chhe.
